name: kage
description: Local pentest sandbox for black-box, greybox, and white-box security audits inside a per-engagement Kali Docker container

interface.shortDescription: Local pentest sandbox in a Kali Docker container
interface.longDescription: Local pentest sandbox for black-box, greybox, and white-box security audits inside a per-engagement Kali Docker container. The Codex port keeps the upstream sidecar and probe scripts, adds a PowerShell shim for Windows, and runs as a single-agent workflow by default.
defaultPrompt: Run the Kage pentest sandbox on this target
Run a recon-only Kage engagement against this domain
Prepare a Kage greybox audit for this target and source path
Use Kage to run recon, verification, and reporting on this domain
